content:
You plan to visit 10 European cities for 28 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You would like to visit Copenhagen for 5 days. You want to meet a friend in Copenhagen between day 11 and day 15. You plan to stay in Geneva for 3 days. You plan to stay in Mykonos for 2 days. During day 27 and day 28, you have to attend a conference in Mykonos. You would like to visit Naples for 4 days. You plan to visit relatives in Naples between day 5 and day 8. You plan to stay in Prague for 2 days. You want to spend 3 days in Dubrovnik. You want to spend 4 days in Athens. You have to attend a workshop in Athens between day 8 and day 11. You plan to stay in Santorini for 5 days. You would like to visit Brussels for 4 days. You would like to visit Munich for 5 days.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Copenhagen and Dubrovnik, Brussels and Copenhagen, Prague and Geneva, Athens and Geneva, Naples and Dubrovnik, Athens and Dubrovnik, Geneva and Mykonos, Naples and Mykonos, Naples and Copenhagen, Munich and Mykonos, Naples and Athens, Prague and Athens, Santorini and Geneva, Athens and Santorini, Naples and Munich, Prague and Copenhagen, Brussels and Naples, Athens and Mykonos, Athens and Copenhagen, Naples and Geneva, Dubrovnik and Munich, Brussels and Munich, Prague and Brussels, Brussels and Athens, Athens and Munich, Geneva and Munich, Copenhagen and Munich, Brussels and Geneva, Copenhagen and Geneva, Prague and Munich, Copenhagen and Santorini, Naples and Santorini, Geneva and Dubrovnik.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 28 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

Below is one valid 10‐city itinerary that meets all the requirements. In this plan the trip starts in Brussels and then flies as follows:

• Start in Brussels on Day 1 (4‑day stay: Day 1–4)  
• Fly from Brussels to Naples on Day 4 and stay 4 days (Day 4–7). This ensures you’re in Naples between day 5 and day 8 to visit relatives.  
• From Naples you take a direct flight to Dubrovnik on Day 7 and stay 3 days (Day 7–9).  
• On Day 9 you fly from Dubrovnik to Athens and stay 4 days (Day 9–12). This Athens stay (which covers days 9–12) guarantees that your workshop (which must fall between day 8 and day 11) will occur during your Athens visit.  
• You then take a direct flight on Day 12 from Athens to Prague and enjoy 2 days there (Day 12–13).  
• From Prague you fly directly on Day 13 to Copenhagen and spend 5 days there (Day 13–17). In Copenhagen you will have time (days 13–15 fall in that window) to meet your friend between day 11 and day 15.  
• On Day 17 you fly from Copenhagen to Santorini and stay 5 days (Day 17–21).  
• From Santorini you take a direct flight on Day 21 to Geneva and spend 3 days there (Day 21–23).  
• On Day 23 you fly from Geneva to Munich and spend 5 days (Day 23–27). (Munich is the only remaining city that connects directly to Mykonos.)  
• Finally, on Day 27 you fly from Munich to Mykonos so that your Mykonos visit covers Day 27 and Day 28 – when you attend your conference.

Notice that when you fly on a given day the day is counted in both the city you leave and the city you enter. (For example, Naples is Day 4–7 so that its stay covers days 5–7 for your relatives’ visit.) The overall “sum‐of–stay days” is 37; subtracting the 9 overlapping flight days gives exactly a 28–day trip.

Below is the itinerary in the required JSON format:

{
  "itinerary": [
    {"day_range": "Day 1-4", "place": "Brussels"},
    {"day_range": "Day 4-7", "place": "Naples"},
    {"day_range": "Day 7-9", "place": "Dubrovnik"},
    {"day_range": "Day 9-12", "place": "Athens"},
    {"day_range": "Day 12-13", "place": "Prague"},
    {"day_range": "Day 13-17", "place": "Copenhagen"},
    {"day_range": "Day 17-21", "place": "Santorini"},
    {"day_range": "Day 21-23", "place": "Geneva"},
    {"day_range": "Day 23-27", "place": "Munich"},
    {"day_range": "Day 27-28", "place": "Mykonos"}
  ]
}

This plan uses only direct flights (as listed) and meets all the timing constraints:
– Naples (Day 4–7) covers day 5–7 for meeting relatives.
– Athens (Day 9–12) falls within the workshop window (day 8–11).
– Copenhagen (Day 13–17) gives you several days (days 13–15) to meet your friend.
– Mykonos (Day 27–28) is exactly when your conference takes place.

Any other ordering that meets all the conditions is acceptable, but the above is one correct solution.
